title: Sports radio to try in Malta
intro: Radio findings re-checked on 11 October 2026: NET FM is listed at FM 101 MHz with a published weekly grid that includes sports programmes, and WorldDAB's Malta multiplex page confirms three DAB+ multiplexes — Digi B Network (6A, 181.936 MHz), Digi B 3 (6C, 185.360 MHz) and Digi B 2 (12A, 223.936 MHz), where a service named 'Sports Channel' is listed. Rai Radio Uno, carried in Malta's DAB+ line-up, publishes weekend live Italian football coverage. None of this proves a specific fixture, including the esports event, is carried or receivable at the hotel or venue: no on-location reception test was possible.

records.name: NET FM — FM 101 MHz
records.area: Nationwide licensed FM service in Malta
records.hours: NET FM's published weekly grid (re-checked 11 October 2026) lists 'Hits & Score' on Saturday from 16:00, 'Sports Box' on Sunday from 15:00, and 'Mhux Premier biss' on Friday from 18:30, with NET News at 18:00 and 12:00. In this trip window those days are Friday 16, Saturday 17 and Sunday 18 October. The grid shows start times only and does not state a time zone (Malta is UTC+2 in October).
records.description: The Broadcasting Authority's licensed-stations list gives NET FM at 101 MHz FM, and the station's own site carries a weekly grid with three programmes whose names relate to sport. The station page does not describe their content, so names such as 'Hits & Score', 'Sports Box' and 'Mhux Premier biss' (literally 'not only the Premier') are titles only — match commentary or carriage of a named fixture is not confirmed.
records.notes: Frequency source: Broadcasting Authority licensed-stations list https://ba.org.mt/stations-licenced (re-checked 11 October 2026). Programme grid and live stream: https://netfm.com.mt/ (stream link published by the station: https://station.voscast.com/59784f63b730d). The grid is recurring, not a date-stamped 13–19 October 2026 schedule, and does not name fixtures. No TWC, Gżira United–Mosta or Rolex Middle Sea Race radio carriage was confirmed. Recheck the station's schedule close to air time.

records.name: Radio Sportiva — DAB+ directory listing
records.area: Malta DAB+ directory; reception not tested at AX ODYCY or BLAST Arena Studios
records.address: Not published; the directory does not state a multiplex block or tuned frequency
records.hours: Radio Sportiva’s recurring grid lists Diretta Sportiva on Saturday and Sunday, 15:05–17:00. Its schedule page says programming may vary with the sporting events of the day. The date-specific live items shown when checked were for 5–11 October, not 13–19 October.
records.description: Digi B Network's Malta DAB+ channel directory lists Radio Sportiva, an Italian sports station, and Radio Sportiva's own schedule page lists weekend sports programming with a note that programming can vary with the day's events. However, WorldDAB's Malta multiplex service lists for 6A, 12A and 6C, checked the same day, do not name Radio Sportiva. Treat it as a plausible DAB+ service to scan for by name, not as a confirmed current carriage.
records.notes: Malta DAB+ channel directory: https://dab.com.mt/channels/ (listing page dated 2020). WorldDAB service lists checked 11 October 2026: https://www.worlddab.org/why-dab-plus/countries/malta/multiplexes (6A, 6C and 12A do not list Radio Sportiva). Broadcasting Authority licensed DAB services checked the same day do not name it: https://ba.org.mt/stations-licenced. Station schedule and the variance note: https://www.radiosportiva.com/palinsesto/. The conflict between the operator directory and WorldDAB is logged in docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md rather than resolved by guessing.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast if carried; DAB+ receiver required; hardware price not checked

records.name: BBC World Service — DAB+ listing and Sportsworld dates
records.area: BBC World Service appears in Malta’s DAB+ channel directory; reception not tested locally
records.address: Not published; this is a broadcast listing, not a visitor venue
records.hours: BBC's 'Sportsworld' next-on list (re-checked 11 October 2026) shows editions on Saturday 17 October and Sunday 18 October 2026 on BBC World Service 'except News Internet'; the individual episode pages are titled '17/10/2026 GMT' and '18/10/2026 GMT'. The list displays times in the viewer's local time zone, so the exact Malta clock time (UTC+2 in October) must be read off the BBC page or a schedule app rather than converted here.
records.description: BBC World Service carries dated 'Sportsworld' editions on both playoff-weekend days of the trip (17 and 18 October 2026). The programme is described on the BBC's own pages as live sport with news, interviews and analysis, and the 11 October edition's description mentions the English Premier League. The listings do not promise a particular match, and they do not cover the esports event.
records.notes: Dated programme pages: Saturday 17 October https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c92ck0m2cw and Sunday 18 October https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c92ck0q313; next-on list https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/p002w5vq/broadcasts/upcoming (re-checked 11 October 2026; the list labels the feed 'BBC World Service except News Internet'). Earlier checks converted the times from GMT; because the current page renders times in the viewer's local zone, no absolute time is restated here. Malta DAB+ carriage is listed separately in this dataset and reception remains untested.

records.notes: WorldDAB service lists checked 11 October 2026: https://www.worlddab.org/why-dab-plus/countries/malta/multiplexes — Digi B Network 6A includes BBC WS, Rai Radiouno, RTL 102.5, Radio 101, ONE Radio, Magic, Campus FM and others; Digi B 2 (12A) includes a 'Sports Channel' regular service; Digi B 3 is listed as 6C 185.360 MHz. Digi B's own channel list: https://dab.com.mt/channels/. Third-party transmission-site directory (not a reception test): https://www.wohnort.org/dab/malta.html. No receiver scan at the hotel or venue was possible.

records.name: AM / medium wave — no current sports broadcast verified
records.hours: No current AM/MW sports schedule was verified for 13–19 October 2026.
records.description: No current AM or medium-wave sports station was confirmed in the sources checked. The Broadcasting Authority's licensed-stations list (re-checked 11 October 2026) shows nationwide FM services, DAB services and community FM stations, but no current AM/MW sports service. Malta's digital radio capacity is now spread across three DAB+ multiplexes, which is where sports-oriented listening should be checked instead.
records.notes: Checked list: https://ba.org.mt/stations-licenced (no AM service listed; DAB services named are All Rock, Pure Radio, Lite Radio, Maltin Biss, Breeze and Smooth 70s). WorldDAB's Malta multiplex page lists the three DAB+ multiplexes including the 'Sports Channel' on Digi B 2: https://www.worlddab.org/why-dab-plus/countries/malta/multiplexes. Historical note retained: a TVM News article says Radju Malta began on 999 MW and moved to 93.7 FM in 1979 (https://tvmnews.mt/en/news/radju-malta-is-53-years-old/); that is history, not a current AM service. Absence of a listing is not proof that distant AM signals can never be received.

records.area: Nationwide DAB+ multiplex in Malta; reception at the hotel and venue untested
records.address: Not published; this is a radio service entry, not a venue
records.hours: Listed by WorldDAB as a regular DAB+ service; no programme schedule published by the multiplex operator.
records.price range: Free-to-air if carried; DAB+ receiver required; hardware price not checked
records.description: WorldDAB's Malta multiplex page lists a regular DAB+ service named 'Sports Channel' on Digi B 2, block 12A (223.936 MHz). It is the only sports-named service in the current WorldDAB service lists. WorldDAB does not state which broadcaster provides it, and a third-party Malta radio directory separately claims a 'Sports Channel (Talk Sport)' listing on 6C. The brand behind the service is therefore not established, and no schedule or commentary rights were found.
records.notes: Digi B 2 service list on the WorldDAB page (checked 11 October 2026) includes: All Country, All RnB HD, Capital FM, Jazz FM, LBC 97.3, Opera Channel, Smash Radio, 'Sports Channel' and XFM (London). Third-party claim to compare, not to trust: https://radioinmalta.com/en/dab/6c.php (a 'Talk Sport' channel on 6C). The Broadcasting Authority's licensed-station list does not name a 'Sports Channel'. Practical action: scan DAB+ sets by service name on both 12A and 6C and listen to identify the broadcaster; treat TalkSPORT carriage as unconfirmed until then.

records.name: Rai Radio Uno — DAB+ in Malta, Italian football commentary
records.area: Listed on Malta's Digi B Network (block 6A, 181.936 MHz); reception untested
records.address: Not published; this is a broadcast service listing
records.hours: Rai's own programme page states 'Tutto il calcio minuto per minuto' airs on Saturdays and Sundays with Serie A and Serie B coverage; Rai's sport output also includes weekday evening programming. Published in Italian; the pages do not state a time zone, and Italy and Malta share the same civil time in October.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required; hardware price not checked
records.description: WorldDAB's Malta multiplex page lists 'Rai Radiouno' among the services on Digi B Network, block 6A. Rai's own programme page describes 'Tutto il calcio minuto per minuto' as its historic Saturday/Sunday football programme carrying Serie A and Serie B coverage in Italian, with 2026 episodes published on the RaiPlay Sound programme page. For a traveller following Italian football markets, this is the most concrete live-commentary lead found on Malta's DAB+ line-up — but programme carriage on the Maltese multiplex and reception were not tested, and Rai's separate digital-only sports channel is not in the Malta list.
records.notes: Rai programme page (checked 11 October 2026) lists the show as airing 'il sabato e la domenica' with Serie A and Serie B, anticipi and posticipi, including 2026 episodes: https://www.raiplaysound.it/programmi/tuttoilcalciominutoperminuto. Malta DAB+ carriage listing: https://www.worlddab.org/why-dab-plus/countries/malta/multiplexes (Digi B Network 6A lists 'Rai Radiouno'; Rai Radio 1 Sport is a separate digital channel and is not listed there). Rai's press pages describe live match commentary inside 'Sabato Sport' and 'Domenica Sport', for example https://www.rai.it/ufficiostampa/assets/template/us-articolo.html?ssiPath=%2Farticoli%2F2023%2F01%2FTutto-il-calcio-minuto-per-minuto--76f5f516-34cf-4299-9c57-4d98cd4e2298-ssi.html (2023 example, used only to show the format). Commentary is in Italian. Recheck the Rai schedule for 17–18 October and confirm the DAB+ service name on the receiver.
